relationships.subject: morphine
relationships.evidence_quote: Morphine increases the migration and metastasis of mouse melanoma cells by activating TLR4.

relationships.subject: morphine
relationships.evidence_quote: Morphine (0.1, 1, and 10 μM) increased cell migration after 12 hours (p < 0.001)

relationships.subject: CLI-095
relationships.evidence_quote: Treatment with CLI-095 suppressed migration compared to cells treated with morphine alone (p < 0.001).

relationships.subject: morphine
relationships.evidence_quote: Metastatic nodules in the morphine-treated group (64 nodules) were significantly higher than in the control group (40 nodules) (p < 0.05).

key_findings: Morphine increased B16F10 migration and lung metastatic nodules; TLR4 inhibitor CLI-095 blocked the migration
